title: LED basics (steady and blinking)

spans.text: Learn how to turn an LED on and off. Simple but very important.

• Arduino UNO (or similar)
• LED
• 220Ω resistor
• Breadboard
• Jumper wires
An LED only allows current to flow one way. Long leg (+/anode) to positive, short leg (-/cathode) to ground (GND). Always use a resistor with an LED.

1. Connect long leg of LED to Arduino pin 13
2. Connect short leg of LED to one end of 220Ω resistor
3. Connect other end of resistor to GND
Upload the code and watch the LED blink.
Change the delay to make it blink faster or slower.
